title: UpsertInvestmentFund
description: A pooled investment vehicle (open/closed-end fund, ETP, unit trust, SICAV, fund-of-funds). Deliberately distinct from UpsertCompany: funds are major economic actors but not operating companies — GLEIF categorises them separately (entity.category=FUND) and OpenFIGI marks their units securityType2='Mutual Fund'. gmr_id uses the same canonical derivation as companies (UUID5 from LEI or other hard id), so an entity that first entered the graph as a Company keeps its identity; sinks relabel the node :InvestmentFund. Fund unit listings hang off via UpsertListing with company_gmr_id = the fund's gmr_id.

fund_type.description: Granular vehicle type when known — OpenFIGI securityType of its units ('Open-End Fund', 'Closed-End Fund', 'ETP', 'Fund of Funds', ...) or a GLEIF-derived category later.
